Home / Privacy notice

Privacy notice

Last updated: 23 October 2026

THE SHORT VERSION

This site collects almost nothing. There are no accounts, no forms and no analytics. The only things stored are a few small settings in your own browser — like your dark-mode choice — and they never leave your device. The one thing we keep on our side is the record of a WhatsApp tap: which page, the car’s code and the time, and nothing about you. When you contact us, that happens on WhatsApp, on your phone, with a message you can read before you send it.

No accounts

No ads or trackers

WHAT WE STORE
Dark mode choice — If you toggle dark/light, a tiny value called ts-theme is saved in localStorage in your browser. It is not sent to our servers.
Nothing for users — We don't create user accounts or profiles.
A WhatsApp tap — When you tap a WhatsApp link on a car, we record three things so the office knows that car was asked about: the page you tapped from, the car’s code and the time. Nothing about you: no name, no number, no message, no address.
WHAT WE NEVER COLLECT
No email addresses, passwords or phone numbers (unless you write one yourself in a WhatsApp message).
No cookies for tracking, advertising or analytics.
No IP-address logs for marketing.
No third-party trackers (no Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, etc).
WHATSAPP

Enquiries go to WhatsApp directly (+2348146927170). When you tap "Chat on WhatsApp", you leave this site and open WhatsApp. WhatsApp is a separate service with its own privacy policy. Before you leave, this site records that the tap happened — the page, the car’s code (when there is one) and the time — and nothing else. We only see what you choose to send us in that WhatsApp chat.

HOW LONG WE KEEP IT

We store no browsing data beyond that tap record — no name, no number, no message, no address. WhatsApp conversations are kept according to your WhatsApp settings and our normal business retention for sales enquiries. We don't keep copies of full lists of visitors.

YOUR RIGHTS

If you sent us an enquiry and would like it removed, message us on WhatsApp (+2348146927170) with enough detail to identify it — for example the car’s code, or the number you wrote from. We will remove the enquiry, and its imported sheet when no other enquiry or draft is using it. The tap record — the page, the car’s code and the time, and nothing about you — stays. Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have other rights; we’ll try to help.

WHO TO CONTACT

Questions about this notice: message us on WhatsApp.

Owner note: this is a demo privacy notice. Replace the "last updated" date and any contact details before publishing.
